leaves.name: Florian
leaves.body: Since joining you in the office, I've never not seen you happy. You always made time for a coffee and have a chat and somehow still have time to finish your PhD in record time!! Heel erg gefeliciteerd en super veel succes gewenst in de toekomst :)

leaves.name: Albert Gatt
leaves.body: Warmest congratulations on achieving this milestone, Hadi. Thank you for your energy and your goodwill, which leave a lasting impact on the people around you.

leaves.name: Tina
leaves.body: همسر مهربانم، به ثمر نشستن سال‌ها تلاش، درس خواندن و شب‌زنده‌داریت را از صمیم قلب تبریک می‌گویم. تو لایق بهترین‌ها هستی. به تو افتخار می‌کنم. دکتر شدنت مبارک 💗

leaves.name: Donya
leaves.body: Congratulations on your big day and on this great achievement! 🎓🎉I’m so proud of you, and very happy to have you as part of our family. 🌷I hope you have a wonderful and memorable day, and I wish you lots of happiness and success in everything that lies ahead.Wishing you all the best

leaves.name: Rasoul Norouzi
leaves.body: زیبایی مسیر زندگی، پیدا کردن دوستان خوبی مثل هادی برای من بوده. امروز خیلی خوشحالم که این چند خط پیام رو برات ارسال می کنم. تو شایسته بهترین ها هستی رفیق.دکتر شدنت مبارک.

leaves.name: Negin
leaves.body: هادی عزیز،این موفقیت، حاصل سال‌ها تلاش، پشتکار و تعهد توست و امیدوارم جلسه دفاعت به بهترین شکل برگزار شود.برایت آرزو می‌کنم که در تمام مراحل زندگی، همواره سربلند باشی و در کنار موفقیت‌های علمی و حرفه‌ای، همراه با همسر عزیزت، تینا، از سلامتی، آرامش، عشق و روزهایی سرشار از شادی و خوشبختی بهره‌مند باشید.با بهترین آرزوها،نگین

leaves.name: سعید اربابی
leaves.body: هادی عزیز،دوست پرتلاش و دوست‌داشتنی، امیدوارم از لحظه‌لحظه‌ی این روز، که حاصل سال‌ها تلاش بی‌وقفه‌ات است، لذت ببری و در کنار خانواده، دوستان و همکارانت جشن زیبایی داشته باشی.خیلی دوست داشتم در این لحظات در کنارت باشم، اما متأسفانه به‌دلیل سفری که از ماه‌ها قبل هماهنگ شده بود، این افتخار را از دست دادم.دفاع موفق و این دستاورد ارزشمند را از صمیم قلب به تو تبریک می‌گویم و برایت موفقیت‌های روزافزون آرزو دارم.ارادتمند

leaves.name: Jeroen Sparla
leaves.body: Dear Hadi,When you joined AcademicTransfer, it was for one specific project: the CV Priority Sorter, based on Utrecht University’s ASReview. It did not take long, however, for you to discover just how much unexplored AI territory there was within AcademicTransfer. And once you saw it, you were more than happy to dive straight in.Since then, one AI project has led naturally to the next. What started with the CV Priority Sorter has grown into a whole range of projects that somehow all connect. Along the way, we have also found time to work on some ideas of our own, including Conteranto. And now you are even writing a book. About AI, naturally. I honestly do not know where you find the time.What I appreciate most, though, is simply having you as a colleague. You are involved, enthusiastic and nearly always smiling. You work incredibly hard, but you also understand that there should be room for fun alongside all that hard work. That combination makes working with you both inspiring and genuinely enjoyable.I am very happy and proud to call you my colleague, and I know everyone at AcademicTransfer feels the same way. We sincerely hope to keep you with us for many years to come.Congratulations, Dr Hadi. You have truly earned it!

leaves.name: Audrey Peters
leaves.body: Dear Hadi,We are so lucky to have you in our team. Not only for your intelligent, innovative, enthusiastic and creative mind but also - or even more - for your kindness, patience and loyalty. It is really nice to not only follow you in your professional journey but also in your personal journey with Tina and to be a witness of the way you are building your life in the Netherlands (and to get to know all kinds of bureaucratic challenges you have as a knowledge immigrant, not to mention some embarrassing rules such as the one concerning your driver's license). Enjoy the PhD-defense and the ceremony! It's a real milestone.

leaves.name: Roland van Houtert
leaves.body: Dear Dr. Hadi, It is a true privilege to witness your remarkable achievements, with for now its crowning moment: the completion of your doctorate today.. I fully echo the words of Jeroen and Audrey, but I also want to thank you personally and wish you every success. Thank you for being my colleague; a truly kind and pleasant person, and equally wonderful company. You have incredible talents with which you can and will only continue to grow. I consider it an honour to be part of that, at this stage of your life. Good luck with everything that still lies ahead of you. Together with Tina and all your loved ones, I wish you all the very best and most beautiful things life has to offer!

leaves.name: Masoume
leaves.body: Dear Hadi,Congratulations on one of your many big days to come! I am so happy I got to know you and had a chance to work together right before you finish your PhD. Wish you all the best! Cheers,

leaves.name: Qixiang
leaves.body: Dear Hadi, many congratulations on your dissertation and successful defence! I'm always very impressed with your research and work ethics. I wish you all the best.

leaves.name: Shaya Ashouri
leaves.body: هادی عزیز،خیلی خوشحالم که با تو در CUCO آشنا شدم. تو آدم بسیار فهمیده، متواضع، مهربان و دانایی هستی.برایت دنیایی از سلامتی و موفقیت در کار و زندگی آرزو می‌کنم.شایا

leaves.name: Danielle Remmerswaal
leaves.body: Congratulations dr. Hadi! To obtain a PhD you need a lot of endurance. And you did this all in an impressive amount of time. Gefeliciteerd!

leaves.name: Sanli Faez
leaves.body: Dear Hadi,Congratulation for achieving this milestone and creating your solid work on one of the most discussed topics of these years. You work with AI before it was hot, and you keep pioneering new tools that help other people make better decisions.   Working with you on analysing the academic job vacancies has been a very pleasant experience thanks to your hard work and open attitude. You take advice and critical feedback always with a smile and the work you put in implementing those feedback is a clear indication of what a good deep-listener you are.   I am looking forward to learning about the projects and contributions you are creating for improving the conditions of working in academia and beyond.

leaves.name: Thijs Carrière
leaves.body: Dear Dr. Hadi, Congratulations with achieving this milestone!You've done an amazing job. Thank you for always being curious, friendly, and interested in other people's stories!I wish you all the best in all that's next!Best,Thijs

leaves.name: Melanie
leaves.body: Dear Hadi, Congratulations on reaching this big milestone! :) Unfortunately, I am not in Utrecht to raise a glass to you on your defense day, but I am celebrating you from afar. All the best for your future, Melanie

leaves.name: Mohammad Behbahani
leaves.body: Dear Hadi,It is hard to believe we have known each other since 2018, what a long journey! I’m very happy and proud to see you reach this great milestone. Congratulations, Dr Hadi! Wishing you and Tina lots of happiness and success ahead.Mohammad B

leaves.name: Dominik Morawiak
leaves.body: Dear Hadi,Huge congratulations on your PhD! It is a wonderful achievement. It was a pleasure working with you. Wishing you all the best for what comes next!

leaves.name: Mahdi Shafiee Kamalabad
leaves.body: هادی عزیز،همیشه پشتکار، انگیزه و جدیتی که در مسیرت داشتی برای من قابل تحسین بوده. از همان روزهای اول حضورت در دانشگاه، همیشه آماده بودی کارت را ارائه کنی، بازخورد بگیری و برای بهتر شدن تلاش کنی. همیشه این احساس را داشتم که با تمام توانت برای یادگیری و پیشرفت قدم برمی‌داری.با وجود همه فراز و نشیب‌ها، حالا با موفقیت به مرحله دفاع از پایان‌نامه دکتری رسیده‌ای و واقعاً از دیدن این موفقیتت خوشحالم. مطمئنم این نتیجه تلاش، صبر و پشتکار خودت بوده است.با همین انگیزه و انرژی ادامه بده؛ موفقیت‌های بزرگ‌تری در انتظارت خواهد بود.از صمیم قلب برایت در تمام مراحل آینده زندگی و کارت بهترین‌ها را آرزو می‌کنم. موفق و سربلند باشی، دوست عزیز.مهدیDear Hadi,I have always admired your perseverance, motivation, and dedication throughout this journey. From your very first days at the university, you were always willing to present your work, receive feedback, and keep improving. I always felt that you were putting your full effort into learning and developing yourself.Despite all the ups and downs along the way, which are completely normal during a PhD, you have now successfully reached the stage of defending your thesis, and I am very happy to see you achieve this important milestone. It is clearly the result of your hard work.Keep going with the same motivation and energy. I am sure many more successes are waiting for you.I wish you all the very best for your defence and for everything that comes next in your career and life. Mahdi

leaves.name: Simone Cremers
leaves.body: Dear Hadi,Congratulations on this amazing milestone! Although it has been over a year ago now since we were colleagues, it was an honour to witness your expertise. You are a researcher at heart who embraces and discovers the world with plenty of curiosity. Besides, I also know you as very warm and caring for the people around you. I wish you all the best in the next phase of your career and together with Tina at your new home. Enjoy this wonderful moment and great achievement! Warmest regards,

leaves.name: Dennis Bunskoek
leaves.body: Van harte gefeliciteerd Hadi, goed bezig! :)

leaves.name: Robbert Slotman
leaves.body: Beste Hadi, Gefeliciteerd met het bereik van deze mijlpaal! Ik kijk uit naar je verhaal rondom dit uitermate relevante onderwerp. En mooi om jouw kennis en kunde toegepast te zien binnen onze samenwerking voor AcademicTransfer & Leukeleu.

leaves.name: Donald
leaves.body: Beste Hadi,Gefeliciteerd, wat een prestatie. De kennis die jij meebrengt in onze projecten bij Leukeleu voor Academic Transfer is heel inspirerend. Geweldig goed gedaan!

leaves.name: Robert Bagheri
leaves.body: Dear Dr. Hadi! I am very glad that we met after your summer school in Delft, and even shadtar that you ended up becoming a member of my lab and completing your PhD in less than three years! It has been a pleasure having you in the team. Wishing you all the very best for the shiny future ahead!

leaves.name: Frans Visser
leaves.body: Mijlpaal behaald, op naar de volgende ; ) Goed gedaan jochie!

leaves.name: Elena
leaves.body: Dear Hadi,I wish you the best for life after the PhD! I am happy I met you as a peer PhD at M&S, and I hope you will find happiness and satisfaction in your next chapters :)

leaves.name: ریحانه
leaves.body: هادی عزیز؛ خوشحالم در روز دفاعت کنارت خواهم بود. و ممنون از اینکه با صبر و تلاشت الگوی خوبی برای من هستی. رسیدن به این روز احتمالا آسون نبوده اما امیدوارم مسیر زیبات در کنار تینا را ادامه بدی و کنار هم هرروز موفق تر بشید و از زندگیتون لذت ببرید.با آرزوی بهترین ها...✨

leaves.name: Ingrid
leaves.body: Dear Hadi,Congratulations on this milestone! All the hard work has finally paid of!
